items.question: Which authority's approval is required for all eCommerce licences on the UAE mainland?
items.gold: The Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) must approve all eCommerce licences.
items.fact: TDRA approval required for all mainland eCommerce licences.

items.question: Must an online seller in the UAE provide a digital invoice for every transaction?
items.gold: Yes, sellers must provide customers with a clear digital invoice for every transaction.
items.fact: Online sellers must issue digital invoices for every transaction.
